contextualHelp.$description: ContextualHelp's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--contextual-help-<name>) on the page, a container or one ContextualHelp, and every ContextualHelp inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

icon.$description: The "?" of variant help (3:1+ on surface).

info-icon.$description: The "i" of variant info (3:1+ on surface).
